paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar Hakkallir. Heilprin reports a signature in the Ashkenazi machzor for Passover’s seventh day, “I, Elazar ben Yaakov Hakkalliri of Kiryat Sefer in the Land of Israel.” [The Yuchasin gloss describes an acrostic ending at “Kiryat Sefer.”] See Yuchasin’s chronological section, and above, Elazar son of Shimon bar Yochai and Elazar ben Arakh.
